mechanical.title: Reorganize TEST_RUN/UAT docs into docs/tests/Replit/ and docs/tests/UAT/

judgment.preOpenPreflightReason: Unknown. This record was written at the weekly flush by a session that did not run the loop, so no timestamp separates a pre-open preflight phase from the rest of the work. Recorded as null rather than fabricated as zero.
judgment.breakersFired: None fired, but this loop is the clearest ceremony mismatch in the flush window: a pure file-move PR (52 files, docs only, criticality ~5) took THREE reviewer passes. Under working-modes.md's docs-only rule a polish-only round is convergence and earns no successor, so rounds 2 and 3 should not have happened.

notes: Re-derived at the 2026-08-15 /maintenance ledger flush (Claude Code, Opus), NOT narrated in-session at loop close. Cause classification is reconstructed from the PR's own review threads rather than from the build session's memory of them, which is a materially weaker source than PR #443's record had; per the ledger's ambiguous-goes-to-self-inflicted rule, every finding whose cause was not unambiguously new ground was classified as propagation. Mechanical findings is 0 and is recorded as measured, but that number is an undercount of the loop's real content: round 1 raised one genuine finding (PR308/PR425 TEST_RUN-to-UAT sibling links broken by the split into Replit/ and UAT/ directories), and it was delivered in the review BODY rather than as an inline review thread. loop-metrics.mjs counts findings from review threads only, so a body-delivered finding is invisible to it. Recorded as derived rather than hand-corrected, per the never-type-mechanical-values rule; the measurement gap is reported to David in this pass's digest instead. causes therefore sum to the derived 0, and adjudication is n/a (no valid findings in the measured population).
